{{Quote|Angral's dreadnaught has a slight turbolaser advantage over your gunship.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]], comparing the ''Oppressor'' to the [[Hero of Tython]]'s [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Harrower''-class dreadnought''', known more infrequently as the '''''Harrower''-class battle cruiser''', was a heavily-armed class of wedge-shaped [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that was the backbone of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] for over eight and a half [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]; seeing action throughout the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic War]] and the [[Third Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as well as the [[War against Zakuul|war against]] the [[Eternal Empire]]. Produced by [[Taerab Starship Manufacturing]] and measuring around eight hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long with heavily-reinforced [[Hull/Legends|hull]] plating and [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]], the ''Harrower''-class dreadnought carried a complement of over one hundred [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]; a single dreadnought required a crew of 2,400 and could carry 7,300 troops. ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts required an immense amount of energy and materials to produce, and a single dreadnought was capable of taking on starfighters and smaller warships on its own when it was not coordinating Imperial fleets as a command ship.

==Description==
{{Quote|Imperial Star Destroyers are similar to ''Harrowers'' and shall be my tools of discipline among the rebellious systems of the Rim.|[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on the ''Harrower''-class|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
A large [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] that was approximately 800 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, 433 meters in width, and 151 meters in height<ref name="Galactic Strongholds">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref> the ''Harrower''-class dreadnought<ref name="Codex" />&mdash;also known as the ''Harrower''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]]<ref name="Book of Sith" />&mdash;adhered to the wedge-shaped design that had been used for warships of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] since the Empire's founding<ref name="Codex" /> in [[4980 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The "point" of the ''Harrower''-class{{'s}} wedge was split down the middle for a quarter to a third of the length of the ship, forming two prongs. Between those two prongs was one of the ''Harrower''-class{{'s}} hangar bays, with two hangar openings stacked on top of each other and protected by force fields.<ref name="Return" /> Two additional hangars were located on either side of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], between the ends of the forward prongs and two smaller "wings" that protruded from each side closer to the rear of the ship. Two of the ship's shield generators were located on the upper hull of each of those wings, and a final hangar was located on the underbelly of the dreadnought.<ref name="Zosha">{{TORcite|type=space|Zosha Advance}}</ref>

[[File:Sithbattlecruiser.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A ''Harrower''-class under attack]]
A smaller wedge was located on both the top and bottom of the dreadnought towards the rear, and the vessel's command tower was positioned at the rear of the vessel atop that wedge: wing-like protrusions extended out from atop the upper wedge, and the rectangular command tower was built atop the junction of the "wings."<ref name="Zosha" /> ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts sported heavily-reinforced hull plating<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and four [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]],<ref name="Sarapin" /> and the ship featured [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries, [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]], [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], and [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launchers]] as its armaments.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Most ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts had three primary thrusters surrounded by four smaller ones located at the rear of the ship.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

Standard ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts carried a complement of ninety-five [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], most of which were the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy's]] standard [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighter]], as well as thirty-two [[B28 Extinction-class bomber|B28 ''Extinction''-class bombers]] and thirty-five [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts required crews of 2,400 and could carry a complement of 7,300 troops.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The ''Harrower''-class dreadnought also came with a number of [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="Shattering" /> As the largest and most heavily-armed vessel in the Imperial Navy, a single ''Harrower''-class dreadnought was capable of holding its own against fleets of starfighters or several smaller warships, but dreadnoughts were typically used as the backbone of the fleet: ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts normally coordinated fleet attacks while absorbing damage and dealing damage of its own.<ref name="Codex" /> The ''Harrower''-class was produced by [[Taerab Starship Manufacturing]],<ref name="Professional Courtesy" /> and the energy and material cost of building a single dreadnought was roughly equivalent to a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade's]] output of a major [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony.<ref name="Codex" /> After acquiring Makeb resources, Imperial Navy created ships that were using Isotope-5 reactors, making them faster and stronger than most of the other ships. Ships equipped with that technology could be recognized by green glowing.

===Variants===
The ''Harrower''-class saw many revisions and refits over the course of its life, with some of these altering the hull to the point where they were not easily recognizable as a ''Harrower''-class.

[[File:Imperial_navy.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Harrower''-class deployed in the Tingel Arm.]]
'''Tingel Arm-type''': Seen in the [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region]], this variant lacks the widely-split prow of later ''Harrowers'', with the space between the prongs reduced to little more than a narrow slit and leaving the central hangar bay completely obscured.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

'''Early-type''': a model that saw use during the first years of the Great Galactic War, such as during the [[Battle of Korriban]]. The frontal prongs were wider than the Late-type's and were squared off at the ends, and it had a set of four turrets on both the top and bottom sides of the hull's rear wing structures.<ref name="Return" /><ref name="Warfare" />

'''Late-type''': this model saw the most use throughout the era of conflict between the Republic and the Sith Empire, and was seen at the [[First Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="Timeline 5" /> The frontal prongs were narrower and more pointed than on the Early-type, and the turrets on the Early-type's rear wing structures were moved forward to just above the forward hangar bay, forming two rows of four turrets on both the top and bottom of the ship.<ref name="TOR" />

'''''Valor Prevails''-type''': this variant had its frontal hangar bays in a diagonal inset, and the frontal prongs were angled slightly inward so their tips almost met. The only known vessel of this type is the [[Valor Prevails]].<ref name=":0">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 3|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 3]]</ref>

[[BSX-5 Dreadnaught|'''BSX-5 Dreadnaught''']]: Visually similar to the standard ''Harrower''-class, but smaller at 600 meters in length and possessing a reduced armament and complement. The most famous vessel of this type was the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']], flagship of [[Darth Jadus]].<ref name="TOR" />

'''Silencer-type''': this variant stripped out the forward hangar bays to mount the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]] superweapon, a "fleet killer" megalaser with the firepower to destroy a capital ship and recharged quickly enough to do so in rapid succession. The first ship of this type was the [[Doombringer]], and more were constructed to the Sith Empire on the orders of [[Darth Nox]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name=":0" />

'''Gauntlet-type''': nearly identical to the Silencer type in appearance, the main difference was that the superweapon mounted between the prongs was the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]] lightspeed cannon, a weapon capable of destroying ships while they were in hyperspace. The only known example of this ship was destroyed by [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name=":0" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Imperial dreadnaught ''Scream of Ragnos'' is rallying its escort for a major attack in Republic territory. The ''Scream of Ragnos'' is the flagship of Sith Lord Javis Koldor. His dreadnaught led assaults in the Sacking of Coruscant and claimed countless Republic lives.|A Republic mission briefing on the ''Scream of Ragnos''|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:HarrowerClassDreadnaught-EGTW.png|thumb|left|250px|An early-era ''Harrower''-class dreadnought at the Battle of Korriban.]]
The ''Harrower''-class dreadnought was in production as early as [[3712 BBY]], when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]] was given an early model ''Harrower''-class dreadnought ''[[Red Reaper]]'' so that he could conduct his expedition to search for pureblooded [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] outside of the Empire.<ref name="Red Reaper">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Red Reaper}}</ref> The ''Harrower''-class dreadnought had become the primary [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] of the Imperial Navy of the Sith Empire by [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> when the Empire instigated the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Return" /> though the early design&mdash;which was similar to the ''Red Reaper''&mdash;would be phased out over the course of the war.<ref name="Red Reaper" /> ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts were present at the Republic's [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|first contact]] with the Empire in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]],<ref name="Timeline 6" /> and over thirty ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts made up the bulk of the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that [[Battle of Korriban|reclaimed]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] homeworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Return" />

In [[3678 BBY]], several ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts were part of the Imperial fleet that [[Battle over Korriban|defended]] Korriban from a Republic assault in [[3678 BBY]].<ref name="Blood">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref> In [[3671 BBY]], ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts were among the vessels making up the Imperial fleet that attempted to capture the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]&mdash;a Republic victory that became known as the [[First Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="Timeline 5" /> At least three dreadnoughts were present at the [[Battle of Alderaan]] in [[3667 BBY]]<ref name="Hope">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> and ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts also saw use during the [[Rim Campaign]] of [[3661 BBY|3661]]-[[3660 BBY]]&mdash;at least two dreadnoughts were destroyed at the end of the lengthy [[Battle of Ord Radama]] in 3660 BBY.<ref name="Book of Sith" /> A powerful prototype ''Harrower''-class known as the ''[[Voidstar]]'' disappeared during the Great Galactic War, though it was later discovered floating as a derelict during the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Voidstar">{{TORcite|type=warzone|Voidstar}}</ref> ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts such as the ''[[Scream of Ragnos]]'' made up much of the fleet that conducted the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Zosha" /> a battle that brought about the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and the end of the war.<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref>

[[File:Valorprevails.png|thumb|200px|''Valor Prevails'']]
Over a dozen ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts and [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] were stationed at [[Vaiken Spacedock]], the primary staging area of the navy, including the [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|''White Nova'']] and the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] commanded the [[Imperial Fifth Fleet]] from the ''Harrower''-class ''[[Emperor's Glory]]'', which [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]] the Republic transport [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] in [[3643 BBY]] in an effort to capture the Republic ambassador [[Vyn Asara]].<ref name="Esseles">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The ''Esseles''}}</ref> The ''Emperor's Glory'' and the rest of the Fifth Fleet later [[Battle of the Maelstrom|defended]] the [[Maelstrom Prison]] from Republic attack as the [[Galactic War]] began to erupt, but Kilran was killed aboard the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and the ''Emperor's Glory'' was destroyed.<ref name="Maelstrom">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Maelstrom Prison}}</ref>

Knowledge of the design remained for thousands of years, with the Sith Lord [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] remarking on its similarity to his own [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Star Destroyers after he became [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sith_warship.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Oppressor'' design in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace''.]]
The ''Harrower''-class dreadnought was introduced by the multimedia project for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. However, the design was not finalized by the time the tie-in webcomic ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]'' was released in [[2009]], resulting in an altered appearance for the starships. The [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], a ''Harrower''-class dreadnought that is featured in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] storyline of the game, first appeared in the comic.<ref name="Threat of Peace">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 3: Uncertain Surrender]]''</ref>

[[File:Capital_Bombarded.jpg|thumb|250px|A ''Pellaeon'' stand-in for the ''Harrower'' from the ''Timeline 1'' video.]]
''[[Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]'', the first in a series of videos detailing the game's backstory, used concept art of the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] from the [[Legacy era]] in place of the ''Harrower''-class, as the design for the ''Harrower''-class had not yet been finalized by the video's release in [[March]] [[2009]].<ref name="Timeline 2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref> The ''Harrower''-class itself did not actually appear until ''[[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui]]'' in [[October]] 2009, which showed an early design of the ship that featured a less prominent split between the ship's prongs and a wider vessel overall.<ref name="Timeline 5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref>

The [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'']] cinematic trailer, which premiered on [[June 14]], [[2010]], included a side shot of several ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts over the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], though the design continued to undergo revisions. The [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']] cinematic trailer, which premiered in June [[2011]], featured ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts which differed from the finalized version that appeared in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic. ''The ship is thicker than the finalized version, has a different layout for its dorsal dual turbolaser cannons, has an additional 25 triple turbolaser cannons, possesses two additional hangars in on the inner sides of its two-pronged nose, and also possesses traditional circular engines rather than triangular engine arrays.<ref name="Return" /> That rendition was also pictured in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which credited the design to artist [[Ansel Hsiao]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> It should also be noted the ship's in-game appearance varies significantly, including varying armaments such as the use of dual versus quadruple turbolasers,<ref name="Legacy">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=flashpoint|Legacy of the Rakata}}</ref> and also in-game size variation. ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts are a frequent sight in ''The Old Republic'', with several of them serving as hubs in the Imperial Fleet for Sith Empire players<ref name="TOR" /> and others appearing in the game's various space combat missions.<ref name="Zosha" /> Imperial guilds can purchase their own Harrower-class dreadnought as a "Guild Flagship" as part of the "Galactic Strongholds" digital expansion.<ref name="SWTOR GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>
